display.description: Trial Chamber Recall quest offer, reminder, and turn-in scene.
display.title: Trial Chamber Recall

lines: Good. Some work only looks lighter after you pick it back up.
Are you sure you want me to put this quest aside?

abandoned: Then I will set this aside. Come back if the work still matters.
abandoned_cooldown: Then I will set this aside for a while. Let the trail cool before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then this matter is closed. I will not reopen it.
unavailable: There is no active trail here for me to fold away.

lines: Then keep the work close until you are ready.
Trial Chamber Recall is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: A key and a Breeze Rod. Good. That chamber can stay mysterious, but not unmeasured.
inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
missing_objectives: I also need one Breeze Rod for the recall.
missing_proof: Bring a Trial Key. It is the chamber admitting you were there.
missing_target: The items matter after you set foot in the chamber itself.
unavailable: This quest is not ready to close yet.

lines: Then the chamber keeps its opinion of us to itself. For now.
There is a chamber underground that tests people without asking permission. I want a report before it tests us.
A Trial Chamber has been marked nearby. Bring proof, and we decide whether to avoid it or learn from it.

inactive: The conditions for this quest are not right at the moment.
reminder: Trial Chamber near {target_x}, {target_z}. Key, Breeze Rod, return alive enough to explain both.
unavailable: That quest is not in your hands right now.

already_completed: Trial Chamber Recall is already settled.
locate_failed: No chamber answers the map today. Maybe that is mercy.
started: The chamber is {direction}, roughly {distance} blocks from here, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring a Trial Key and one Breeze Rod.
unavailable: This request needs a better equipped ally.

lines: You look like a room argued with you. Did you win anything useful?
Then hold onto it until you are ready to settle the matter.
